definition.question: How deadlocked are Gaza ceasefire/hostage talks and Israel-Arab normalization?
definition.low_end: A durable Gaza ceasefire and hostage exchange is in effect with active mediation and advancing Israel-Arab normalization agreements.
definition.high_end: Ceasefire and hostage negotiations have completely collapsed, mediation is severed, and regional normalization is frozen or reversed amid diplomatic rupture.
